interpretation: The document inventory covers Git-listed Markdown and llms.txt; HTML count surfaces are tracked separately. Audience follows the website publication policy, not npm membership. Source paths locate repository evidence and need not all be packaged. Roles describe source routing and audience, not approval, factual freshness of every sentence, translation quality or capability certification.
countScope: Counts describe declared inventory only. Declared language/theme/boolean controls are inventory facts, not proof of complete content, working behavior or every supported state; token declarations and typed base values are distinct counts.
